Let \(\mathcal M_{25}\) be the Deligne–Mumford moduli stack of smooth, connected, projective curves of genus \(25\), and let \(\pi:\mathcal C_{25}\to\mathcal M_{25}\) be its universal curve. Write \(\mathrm{CH}^k(-;\mathbb Q)\) for the Chow group of codimension-\(k\) algebraic cycles with rational coefficients modulo rational equivalence. For each integer \(i\geq 1\), define

\kappa_i=\pi_*\bigl(c_1(\omega_\pi)^{i+1}\bigr)\in\mathrm{CH}^i(\mathcal M_{25};\mathbb Q),
\]

Let \(R^*(\mathcal M_{25})\) be the graded \(\mathbb Q\)-subalgebra of \(\mathrm{CH}^*(\mathcal M_{25};\mathbb Q)\) generated by these classes, with grading by codimension. What is the exact value of \(\dim_{\mathbb Q}R^{12}(\mathcal M_{25})\)?

Printing what you believe is not evidence. Proving it takes two halves. Split the halves, and the pieces of each, between you on Slack.
